usage: deskops runtime [-h]
                       {init,status,attach,stop,workers,supervise,template} ...

positional arguments:
  {init,status,attach,stop,workers,supervise,template}
    init                Initialize or reuse this desk's Herdr Space.
    status              Show this desk's Herdr Space.
    attach              Focus this desk's Herdr Space.
    stop                Close this desk's Herdr Space.
    workers             List live Herdr agents across all workspaces on this
                        machine.
    supervise           Block on one agent's Herdr lifecycle and report
                        blocked/done settles without advancing the desk.
    template            Materialize a RoleDoc + RuntimeProfileDoc as a Scion
                        agent template (scion-agent.yaml, system-prompt.md,
                        agents.md).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
